product.title: Wagvive Cooling Comfort Mat
product.body_html:
Relief from the heat, without the plug.

A pressure-activated cooling gel mat that stays cool for hours without ice, water, or electricity. Especially valuable for senior pets, thick-coated breeds, or anyone living somewhere warm. Rolls up for easy storage or travel, and wipes clean in seconds.

  • No electricity, refrigeration, or water required
  • Pressure-activated cooling technology
  • Supportive for aging joints
  • Easy wipe-clean surface
